cohort: 830 pregnant women beyond 20 weeks of gestation with severe antepartum hypertension
finding: Intravenous nicardipine was found to be an effective and safe treatment for severe antepartum hypertension in pregnancy, with a high success rate and an acceptable safety profile.
mod_finding: One case of fetal distress was attributable to maternal hypotension caused by nicardipine, leading to a cesarean section.
